response.sql: WITH order_rates AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY o.orderspivot, u.acctscope HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(f.rebrate) IS NOT NULL), scope_rates AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS average_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_rates GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, average_net_fee_rate, order_count, average_net_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(average_net_fee_rate) FROM scope_rates) AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_rates

assumptions.assumption: A matched user with a NULL acctscope forms a NULL scope group and contributes to the plain average of scope averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Only users with a specified account scope count.
